Rhipicephalus sanguineus (brown dog tick)] for 12 weeks

Bravecto is also indicated for the treatment and control

for 8 weeks in dogs and puppies 6 months of age and
older, and weighing 4.4 pounds or greater.
Dosage and Administration: Bravecto should be
administered topically as a single dose every 12 weeks
to provide a minimum dose of 11.4 mg/lb (25 mg/kg)
body weight. Bravecto may be administered every
8 weeks in case of potential exposure to Amb/yomma
americanum ticks. Treatment with Bravecto may begin
at any time of the year and can continue year round
Precautions: For topical use only. Avoid oral ingestion.

Bravecto has not been shown to be effective for
12-weeks duration in puppies less than 6 months of
age. Bravecto is not effective against Amblyomma
americanum ticks beyond 8 weeks after dosing.
Human Warnings: Not for human use. Keep this and all
drugs out of the reach of children. Do not contact or
allow children to contact the application site until
dry. Wash hands and contacted skin thoroughly with
